author: Apple Explained
description:
The new Apple TV looks exactly like the last one, with the same box, the same remote, and the same 128 gigabytes of storage. But there's one big difference: the price.

Earlier this year, this configuration cost $149. Today it costs $299. Apple didn't raise the price by 10 or 20 percent. It doubled it.

Apple raised prices on almost everything this year, but nothing else came close to doubling. So why did this little streaming box get hit so hard? The answer goes back to the very first model, and to a decision the company made more than fifteen years ago that's now coming back to bite it.
title: Why The Apple TV's Price Keeps Going Up
